privacy_policy: No identifiers, private clinical data, raw notes, local file paths, documents or slide images in generation payload. Public visibility is not export permission. Human-reviewed minimal abstraction required before any future external dispatch. Automatic external dispatch is prohibited; only human-triggered generation of controlled packets is supported.
asset_lifecycle: generation only after separate enablement and export authorization
human visual and scientific safety review of exact asset plus placement preview
append approval event with exact scope
verify hashes, project, deck, slide, role, transforms, and revocation at insertion
render composite slide and require final deck review
post_generation_rejection: forbidden evidence-like appearance even if prompt was safe
misleading anatomy, laterality, instruments or care claims
generated text, numbers, traces or chart axes
wrong palette or insufficient protected whitespace
failure_action: Keep CANDIDATE quarantined; record decision. Missing optional illustration can yield explicit NONE. A missing scientific figure or unsafe semantic relationship remains INFORMATION_REQUIRED. No silent replacement or auto-approval.
